tolerance_history: First frozen bound was 0.03 relative L2 on every component, before any run. The all-query decoder box comparison measured 0.0327 and was moved to 0.1 afterwards: the error sits in background queries (maker score < 0.02) and the maker's own BF16 run differs from its FP16 run there by 0.26 with the same selection. Confident boxes stay at 0.03. Index-by-index end-to-end comparison was replaced by order-free matching because one-ULP FP16 score differences reorder exact ties in the top-300 selection, and each rank carries its own learned query.
fixed_bugs: Runner hard-coded Nano's 384 px and two decoder layers; it now reads image_size, decoder_layers and backbone sizes from config.json (RFDETRLargeTests.shapeFollowsEachPinnedConfig).

Two-stage top-300 selection used argPartition + argSort, which does not keep torch.topk's tie order; 104 of the photo's 299 adjacent top-300 pairs are exact FP16 ties. Selection now runs as torch.topk does (RFDETRLargeTests.topKSelectionBreaksTiesByPositionLikeTorch). Applies to Nano too.
